title: DTCR verification receipt
description: What one verification arrival actually observed against one exact commit. Arrival is a single value because a receipt describes one kind of reaching: static analysis reports that a thing is possible, a sandboxed run reports that it executes under synthetic input, and a production observation reports that it ran with these values. Coverage is either the literal NOT_MEASURED or a numerator over a named denominator, so the receipt has no field in which to write a percentage on its own; a numerator equal to its denominator is a fact about that denominator and is not a statement about the parts nobody counted. The summary refuses ten listed spellings of the absolute vocabulary, which is a word filter and not a check on meaning: a paraphrase that avoids all ten passes, and 'complete coverage of the boundary with no false positives whatsoever' is one such paraphrase. The filter catches the habitual phrasing so that writing the claim takes a deliberate rewording; catching the rewording is a reviewer's job and this keyword does not do it.

arrival.description: One arrival per receipt. Two receipts of the same arrival are one arrival observed twice, and a load-bearing invariant that cost something to get wrong wants two arrivals that cannot be fooled by the same mistake.

denominator_definition.description: What was counted. Without it the ratio describes a set the reader invents, and the set the reader invents is always the whole system.

performance.description: A latency, throughput or productivity figure is admissible only with its method, sample size, environment and exact commit.

summary.description: Ten literal spellings of the absolute vocabulary are refused here rather than discouraged elsewhere. This is a word filter over recorded phrasings, not a check on what the sentence means; a paraphrase that avoids all ten is accepted and stays a reviewer's problem. A receipt whose checks all passed is a receipt about the checks that ran.

exit_code.description: null only when the check did not run. An outcome with no exit code and no explicit absence is a claim about a process nobody started.

coverage.denominator_definition: the eight schema documents shipped under references/schemas in this change
coverage.method: each schema validated against the dialect, then its own positive and negative control cases replayed

examples.summary: Every shipped schema is a valid 2020-12 document and every recorded refusal control was replayed and refused on these bytes.

x-refusal-controls.refuses: A bare absolute coverage claim with no denominator.

x-refusal-controls.refuses: An absolute security or compliance guarantee written into the summary prose.

instance.summary: This pass gives 100% coverage of the architecture boundary with zero false positives.
